title: One object, several interfaces

blocks.text: A class can implement several interfaces, so one object can be an instance of several interface types at once. Each one is tested on its own.
Write `of(Object obj)` in `Abilities`. It returns, in this order, the names of the interfaces among `Runnable`, `Comparable` and `CharSequence` that `obj` is an instance of:

items: a `String` is both comparable and a character sequence: `of("hi")` is `["Comparable", "CharSequence"]`;

cases.says: A Thread is Runnable and an Integer is Comparable.

concepts: One object can be an instance of several interfaces at once.
